info.title: edatalia Sign Online Universal API
info.description: edatalia Sign Online provides REST APIs for creating and managing digital signature envelopes, retrieving signed documents and evidence, applying server-side electronic signatures and timestamps, and validating signed PDFs.

get.description: Retrieves an envelope audit trail from edatalia Sign Online.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: documentSetId
parameters.description: Identifier of the envelope whose audit trail should be retrieved.

schema.description: Identifier of the envelope whose audit trail should be retrieved.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

get.description: Retrieves envelope details from edatalia Sign Online.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: documentSetId
parameters.description: Identifier of the envelope to retrieve.

schema.description: Identifier of the envelope to retrieve.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

creationDate.description: Date and time when the envelope was created.

documents.description: Documents in the envelope, including document id, name, and hash when returned.

documentSetReference.description: Customer or external reference for the envelope.

downloaded.description: Whether the signed documents have been downloaded.

estimatedPurgationDate.description: Estimated date and time when documents may be purged.

expirationDate.description: Date and time when the envelope expires.

flowName.description: Flow name used to create the envelope, when present.

flowTokenId.description: Flow token identifier used to create the envelope, when present.

listDatesReminderDays.description: Specific reminder dates for the envelope.

purgated.description: Whether the envelope documents have been purged.

purgationDate.description: Date and time when the envelope documents were purged.

recipients.description: Recipients in the envelope, including signer identity and action status details when returned.

senderMail.description: Email address of the envelope sender.

sendMethod.description: Send method used for the envelope.

statusTime.description: Date and time when the envelope reached its current status.

teamId.description: Team identifier associated with the envelope.

teamName.description: Team name associated with the envelope.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
